objective: Build a governed corpus that recognizes potentially PV-relevant language and routes it for human review without determining medical causality.

datasets.contains: Source-faithful FDA FAERS/openFDA cases with nested drugs, reactions, outcomes, raw records, provenance, and deduplication metadata.

Versioned safety concepts that preserve source MedDRA Preferred Terms and propose equivalent or closely related mapping candidates without inventing official hierarchy; mappings remain pending qualified PV review.
Draft governed consumer, colloquial, symptom, temporal, and causal expression candidates linked to source-preserved taxonomy concepts; all mappings remain pending qualified PV/medical review.
Synthetic draft examples separating PV relevance, P/R/D/E completeness, and routing across eleven balanced contextual and special-situation classes; every record remains pending human adjudication.

assumptions.statement: FAERS/openFDA is a regulatory signal source and does not establish incidence or causality.
Source-provided MedDRA Preferred Terms may be preserved, but absent official hierarchy values or codes will not be invented.
PV relevance and ICSR completeness are separate labels; a potentially relevant mention may have one or more unknown P/R/D/E elements.
Human PV reviewers are the authority for adjudication, escalation, and correction of model- or rule-suggested labels.
Every derived artifact must be traceable to a source record, configuration version, transformation version, and review state.
The initial topic registry covers the six configured botulinum toxin product families and can be superseded through versioned configuration.

unresolvedDecisions.question: Which licensed MedDRA release and hierarchy access may be used beyond source-provided Preferred Term strings?
Which approved social sources, languages, retention rules, and reuse rights may contribute observed consumer expressions?
What reviewer qualifications, dual-review sampling rate, disagreement process, and adjudication authority govern gold labels?
What recall, precision, subgroup, and false-negative thresholds are required before a classifier can be promoted?
Will historical FAERS versions be acquired from quarterly extracts, and how will amendments be represented across releases?
Where will complete multi-gigabyte immutable corpus releases be retained, encrypted, access-controlled, and promoted?

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: All four datasets have versioned contracts and declared dependencies.
The pipeline explicitly separates PV relevance from ICSR P/R/D/E completeness and requires human review for escalation.
Assumptions and unresolved governance decisions are versioned and assigned to an owner.
All configured brands and active ingredients are queryable by exact source fields, with optional suspect-drug designation.
Raw and normalized records retain identifiers, nested drugs/reactions/outcomes, query provenance, hashes, configuration versions, and causality_status=NOT_ESTABLISHED.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Schema, normalization, provenance, and storage tests.

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: Rate limits, pagination, malformed records, duplicate observations, conflicting payloads, and partial snapshots are auditable.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Fixture-based failure, retry, deduplication, and immutable-output tests.

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: Every taxonomy concept has a stable versioned ID, provenance, review status, and at least one source term.
Source MedDRA Preferred Terms remain unchanged and official codes/hierarchy appear only when source-provided or licensed and versioned.
Equivalent and related concept mappings are human-reviewed, reversible, and retain mapping rationale and confidence.

A versioned draft generation layer retains every source taxonomy concept, requires parent mappings and provenance for every expression, and prevents unreviewed language from becoming production-eligible.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Fixture-based concept-retention, referential-integrity, provenance, immutable-output, and production-eligibility tests.

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: Expressions are linked to reviewed taxonomy concepts and labeled by language, expression type, origin, confidence, and validation state.
Observed, human-authored, and model-suggested language remain distinguishable and source rights are recorded.
The library covers clinical terms, consumer phrasing, colloquialisms, misspellings, symptom descriptions, and temporal/causal language without asserting causality.
A versioned synthetic draft uses source-linked contrast sets, controlled PV/ICSR labels, complete provenance, and mandatory human-review status without making final reportability determinations.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Schema, provenance, label-consistency, prohibited-language, and immutable-output tests.

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: The corpus represents all eleven configured example classes with balanced positive, uncertain, negative, informational, and special-situation contrast sets.
Every example separately records PV relevance, P/R/D/E status, evidence spans, routing, confidence, and human adjudication.
Near duplicates and source/case families cannot leak across train, validation, and test partitions.
A versioned gold-candidate dataset, append-only adjudication workflow, segmented metrics, and locked false-negative regression set are available for qualified PV review.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Validation-harness quality tests and immutable evaluation run manifest.

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: Performance is measured by label, product family, expression type, source, and ICSR element on a locked holdout set.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Versioned evaluation report and reproducible run manifest.

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: PV-approved thresholds, error review, limitations, and rollback criteria are documented before promotion.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Signed model-risk and PV-quality approval record.

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: The promoted classifier routes candidates to human review and does not independently determine causality or final reportability.
Corpus releases are immutable, access-controlled, checksummed, reproducible, and linked to source/configuration versions.
Code-list, taxonomy, product-registry, and source updates create new versions with reviewed migration and rollback paths.
Drift, false-negative review, reviewer overrides, and data-quality exceptions are monitored without rewriting historical labels.
acceptanceCriteria.verification: Operational dashboard and append-only audit tests.

activationPolicy: Published configurations and schemas are immutable. Changes require a new version, automated validation, governance review, and an explicit manifest activation update.
